recap.headline: Duncairn Harbour Secures Dramatic Late Victory Against Rivermouth Rovers
recap.summary: Duncairn Harbour hosted Rivermouth Rovers at Lighthouse Arena in a thrilling match. After falling behind to a goal by Leon Navarel in the first half, Duncairn Harbour mounted a comeback. Amir Vasconel equalized in the second half before Samir Esperon scored the winning goal in stoppage time to seal a 2-1 victory.
turning_points: 37' Leon Navarel opens the scoring to give Rivermouth Rovers the lead.
66' Amir Vasconel scores to equalize for Duncairn Harbour.
90+3' Samir Esperon scores the dramatic late winner for Duncairn Harbour.
